7637.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
objectivesText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7641.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
objectivesText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

7642.name: Collection of Goods
objectivesText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

7643.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
objectivesText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

7644.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
objectivesText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7645.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
objectivesText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

7646.name: The Divination Scryer
objectivesText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7647.name: Judgment and Redemption
objectivesText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

7648.name: Grimand's Finest Work
objectivesText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

7649.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7650.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7651.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

places.name: Whistle of the Mottled Red Raptor

7667.name: Material Assistance
objectivesText: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

7668.name: The Darkreaver Menace
objectivesText: Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

7670.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7677.name: White Stallion Exchange
objectivesText: If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.
MUST PAY 500 Gold too....

7701.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
objectivesText: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

7703.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
objectivesText: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

7704.name: Look at the Size of It!
objectivesText: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

7721.name: Fuel for the Zapping
objectivesText: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7722.name: What the Flux?
objectivesText: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

7723.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

7724.name: Fiery Menace!
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.

7725.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
objectivesText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7726.name: Refuel for the Zapping
objectivesText: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7727.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

7728.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
objectivesText: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

7729.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
objectivesText: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

7730.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
objectivesText: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7731.name: Stinglasher
objectivesText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7732.name: Zukk'ash Report
objectivesText: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

7733.name: Improved Quality
objectivesText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7734.name: Improved Quality
objectivesText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7735.name: Pristine Yeti Hide
objectivesText: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7736.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood

7738.name: Perfect Yeti Hide
objectivesText: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7761.name: Blackhand's Command
objectivesText: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

7781.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7782.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

7783.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

7784.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.

7785.name: Examine the Vessel
objectivesText: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

7786.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
objectivesText: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
objectivesText: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

7788.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

7789.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.

7810.name: Arena Master
objectivesText: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.

7815.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
objectivesText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

7816.name: Gammerita, Mon!
objectivesText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

7828.name: Stalking the Stalkers
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7829.name: Hunt the Savages
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7830.name: Avenging the Fallen
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7839.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
objectivesText: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

7840.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
objectivesText: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

7841.name: Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

7842.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

7843.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

7844.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
objectivesText: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

7845.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
objectivesText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

7846.name: Recover the Key!
objectivesText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

7847.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
objectivesText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

7848.name: Attunement to the Core
objectivesText: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.

7849.name: Separation Anxiety
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

7850.name: Dark Vessels
objectivesText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

7861.name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
objectivesText: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

7862.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
objectivesText: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

7871.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

objectivesText: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

objectivesText: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

objectivesText: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.

objectivesText: Return the Beast Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

7929.name: Darkmoon Elementals Deck

7937.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest and seek out your fortune.

7938.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to the Deadmines in Westfall and seek out your fortune.

7944.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to the Wailing Caverns in the Barrens and seek out your fortune.

7945.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to Palemane Rock in Mulgore and seek out your fortune.

objectivesText: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8080.name: Arathi Basin Resources!
objectivesText: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.

8081.name: More Resource Crates
objectivesText: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.

8105.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
